problem: Production pricing browser proof failed because no visible mobile language select existed on /prijzen.
root_cause: The canonical source file prijzen.html did not contain the i18n CSS/runtime assets itself. Normal builds could inject them through apply-i18n.mjs, but exact-source recovery delivery could expose the canonical source without that enrichment, so the mobile language control was never mounted.
prevention: Canonical pricing source must include /assets/i18n.css and /assets/js/i18n.js with data-bg-i18n-asset markers.
The site-wide apply-i18n step remains idempotent and must not duplicate those assets.
Production pricing browser proof must require a visible mobile language select and a successful NL→EN→NL roundtrip.
Exact-source production recovery must not depend on build-only injection for critical navigation controls.
